verdict.rationale: Segment documents Reverse ETL, which extracts warehouse data using a query you provide and syncs it to third-party destinations. This covers defining models on existing warehouse tables and activating them without re-collecting the data. The pricing page also mentions unifying warehouse data into profiles. However, the Audiences docs describe building audiences from tracked events, traits and computed traits, not directly on warehouse tables. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of building audiences natively on warehouse tables (warehouse-native audience definition), detail on model management and sync scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Reverse ETL.
